answer: Make trust a zenith beacon no farm can light at signup: a newcomer must first pass a hollow-core audit, where unrelated veterans whisper-check its claimed work sealed, so no clique can rehearse one story together. Each verified job adds one signed link to a chain bound to a single key, and standing climbs only as fresh independent whispers accumulate. Summit audits re-check the chain each epoch, freezing any beacon whose links repeat signers or tasks. Sybil farms must earn a beacon, survive hollow audits, and gather new whispers for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
